text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though trembling with fear, Tamamo Cross 
claimed victory in the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What washed over was relief rather than 
the joy of victory. Without being able to 
shake the lingering shock of the accident, 
it was a glory steeped in bruises and 
scars...
